node.title: Re^5: Capture STDOUT and send to screen with open3
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I will not always have root access.

You can install Perl modules without root access, see [mod://local::lib] and [id://693828].

Update: And [mod://IPC::Run], which you seem to [id://1210363|want to use], is not a core module either, so that would have to be installed too.
